activation_condition: Activate if rootedstock_execnet12v4 has one or more demonstrably non-equivalent pairs on its fresh screen.

source_basis.movement_scope: The default logistics.reallocation_destination_scope is adjacent. A focal locality's next-command incoming relocations can therefore be generated only by formations currently in its one-hop graph neighborhood.
source_basis.current_reduced_state_gap: The current local closure state represents the neighborhood only through mean clipped membership depth. It does not retain neighboring transportable force, rooted reservoir, or recruitment hazard.
source_basis.hypothesis: The residual is a missing spatial Markov blanket rather than temporal memory: local transition distributions become approximately closed when direct one-hop source-reservoir state is included.

coordinate_rationale.log_neighbor_rooted_mass: durable one-hop insurgent stock that can replenish source formations
coordinate_rationale.log_neighbor_recruitment_hazard: current one-hop regeneration flow into that reservoir

fresh_screen.nomination_rule: Zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs required; 16 branches cannot certify closure.
fresh_screen.falsifier: One or more demonstrably non-equivalent pairs rejects the one-hop Markov blanket as sufficient 30d closure.

fresh_confirmation.activation: Only if fresh_screen has zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs.

contingent_ring2_rule.activation: Only if the one-hop candidate fails and its demonstrable failures remain transport/reproduction dominated.
contingent_ring2_rule.theory: Over a 30d horizon repeated adjacent moves allow two-hop state to enter the focal Markov blanket indirectly. A ring-2 extension is then topologically motivated rather than ad hoc.
contingent_ring2_rule.guard: Do not define or test ring-2 coordinates after seeing fresh ring-1 future outcomes unless a separate contract freezes their exact aggregation first.

scientific_guard: A PASS would support graph-local synthetic closure under the tested topology and horizon. It would not imply that real insurgencies have a one-hop geographic Markov blanket.
